column1: # Registry of write sites in update.sh (WP-529 Ф245, step 1). Checked by test-update-write-sites.sh.
# block: fn:NAME (enclosing function) or top:Step N (top level under that header).
# class: A = file write to the install / memory / workspace / governance repo
#        B = outside script or tool that writes on its own
#        C = non-file effect (scheduler, shell rc, git config)
#        H = helper that writes to the path its caller passes (coverage follows the caller)
#        R = read only (false positive of the scanner: classifier, probe, git read)
#        T = temporary file or directory outside the install
# coverage: plan = goes through the frozen plan and the single executor;
#           staging = outside script builds its output in staging, update.sh applies it by plan;
#           atomic+inverse = outside script is one atomic operation with an inverse;
#           not-covered = rollback does not undo it, the update summary says so;
#           caller = see the calling block; none = nothing to undo.
# "provisional" in notes = classified from the block's commands and callers, re-check when the executor is built (step 2).
